title: PLE I/O overlap and thread-pool tuning - execution and acceptance
analysis: PLE is <0.5% of TPOT (12): 16 rows x 1.19 us ~= 19 us vs ~46 ms/step = 0.04%.
There is no headroom >=5% for overlap/thread tuning to win; the C++ extension could not add value here.
decision: no_change: keep the current PLE disk path; no overlap/thread-pool change adopted.
limitations: Workload-dependent PLE locality (12); no new measurement beyond the 12 analysis.
